desc: Ideation: functional-graph decomposition with cycle equality and tree DP F_u(t)=F_u(t-1)+prod_children F_v(t).
Parse input, build children lists and indegree counts; run Kahn pruning to mark cycle nodes and get leaf-to-root order.

Allocate G (non-cycle accumulators) and P (cycle accumulators) as [1]*(M+1); process non-cycle nodes in order, prefix-sum G to get F, multiply F into parent's P (cycle parent) or G (non-cycle parent), and free G.
For each cycle, pointwise-multiply its cycle nodes' P arrays over t, sum over t=1..M, multiply components into the answer mod 998244353.
Verify against samples 6 / 2025 / 10010 and edge cases: N=1 self-loop (M), M=1, multi-node cycle, star, and a chain.
Confirm O(N*M) time/memory fits N,M<=2025 and pass the sample-test verdict.
